requirements.text: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related field.
Solid programming skills in Python and/or C++, with experience developing, testing, or debugging software for robotics, machine learning, or related technical applications.
Foundational understanding of robotics concepts, such as robot kinematics, control, perception, sensing, or robotic system integration.
Hands-on experience with robotics hardware, simulation, or substantial robotics software projects, gained through coursework, research labs, internships, personal projects, or robotics competitions.
Strong practical problem-solving skills, willingness to learn unfamiliar tools and technologies, and ability to troubleshoot technical challenges independently.
Good communication and collaboration skills, attention to technical detail, and enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary research and engineering environment.
Experience with robotic platforms such as manipulators, dexterous hands, mobile robots, or humanoid robots, including hardware integration, control, or experimental deployment.
Familiarity with ROS/ROS 2, robot communication interfaces, motion planning, or robotic control software.
Experience with cameras, depth sensors, tactile sensors, force/torque sensors, motion capture systems, or multimodal sensor integration.
Experience with data acquisition, sensor calibration, temporal synchronization, data processing, or large-scale robotics datasets.
Familiarity with robot learning methods such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning, diffusion policies, or vision-language-action models.
Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX, including training, fine-tuning, or evaluating learning-based models.
Experience with robotics simulation tools such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or related environments.
Experience with CAD, mechanical prototyping, 3D printing, electronics, or embedded systems.
Previous experience in an academic robotics lab, robotics competition, engineering internship, or substantial independent robotics project.
Contributions to open-source robotics software, technical projects, datasets, or research publications are a plus, but not required.
